canonical_name: Physical Access to System Components Not Controlled
description: Physical access to system hardware and components is not restricted to authorized personnel. This signal indicates that unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to equipment, enabling tampering or theft.
applicability: Applicable to all physical system components. Includes server rooms, network closets, workstation security, and portable device controls.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through physical security assessment, access control mechanism review, and physical access log analysis.
